blocks.text: Setting up Gmail on your Mac

Because there is no official Gmail app, you should create a web app to keep your inbox separate from your other browser tabs. In Chrome, go to the three-dot menu, select Save and Share, then choose Install page as app. In Safari, go to File, then Add to Dock. This gives you a dedicated icon in your Dock for faster access.

Shortcuts are disabled by default. Go to Settings, then General, and check the box for Keyboard shortcuts. Once enabled, press Shift plus forward slash to see the full list of commands. Use the Command key instead of Control for all shortcuts.

items: a: Reply all to a message

blocks.text: Managing high email volume as a BDR

BDRs often handle over 120 emails a day. Use labels and filters to sort incoming messages from prospects. Go to Settings, then Filters and Blocked Addresses to create rules based on sender or subject line. This keeps your inbox clean and ensures you do not miss important responses.
Hold Option plus Command to ask Lazur about any email content on your screen. It can summarize long threads or help you find specific prospect details without leaving your inbox.
blocks.title: Use Lazur for quick research

blocks.text: Writing repetitive emails wastes time. Use your own templates or the built-in templates feature in Gmail. Go to Settings, then Advanced, and enable Templates. Save your common outreach messages to reuse them quickly. When you need to customize a draft, hold the fn key to dictate your thoughts directly into the body of the email.

Do not send more than 500 recipients in a single day if you are on a personal account. Workspace accounts allow up to 2,000. Exceeding these limits can lead to your account being blocked for 24 hours. Always double-check your CC and BCC fields before hitting send.

Lazur works in the background to handle your research and organization. Use it to draft responses or find information while you stay in your email flow. It does not click buttons for you, but it can point out where settings are or guide you through complex tasks one step at a time.

Interruptions happen every two minutes. Use the snooze feature to hide emails that do not require immediate attention. Hover over an email and click the clock icon to pick a time for it to reappear in your inbox. This helps you focus on high-priority prospects during your dedicated outreach blocks.

faq.question: Is there a native Gmail app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, Google does not provide a native desktop app. You must use a browser or a third-party email client that supports OAuth.

faq.question: How do I enable keyboard shortcuts in Gmail?
faq.answer: Go to Settings, then General, and select Keyboard shortcuts to turn them on.

faq.question: How many emails can I send per day?
faq.answer: Personal accounts are limited to 500 recipients per day, while Workspace accounts can send up to 2,000.

faq.question: Does Lazur click buttons in Gmail for me?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not click buttons or edit files. It helps you by pointing at items, answering questions, and dictating text.
